'''Catastrophe Gloves''' is a {{gear|4|Gloves}}gear item.

{{Item description|Designed by Triglava Armoury and assembled by the AIC. This equipment improves the wearer's combat capabilities.|Part of an exoskeleton suit equipped by crystal growers at the Originium Science Park. 
Key adjustments include supporting structures at the finger joints and improved gripping strength. These gloves greatly improve work performance when cutting and carrying slabs of crystals from Originium clusters.}}
